messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Rachel,

Further to today's agreement, please find the draft Settlement Agreement attached, reflecting the £115,000 total and the agreed reference at the Schedule. Grateful for any comments. We've drafted it to record £30,000 taxable and £85,000 compensation per Sarah's offer.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Okafor — draft Settlement Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Thank you. My mark-up is attached. Substantively we are agreed on the £115,000; my changes are: payment within 14 days rather than 28; the costs contribution at £1,500 (as agreed) rather than the £750 in your draft; and a new clause 6.2 requiring an internal announcement in a form approved by my client. I have not touched the compensation figure, which remains £85,000.

Rachel

Rachel Hartley
Partner
Birchall Stone LLP
18 Cornhill, London EC3V 3ND
